From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Javier Rosales <j.rosales@lumensoft.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@lumensoft.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC jumpstart - compact checklist, owners & this-week asks

Thanks for the call this morning — good alignment from the discovery. Summarizing next steps so we can kick the PoC off next week without friction. Attaching a short runbook and a metrics template for the evaluation.

Top-line success criteria (proposed):
- Latency: 95th percentile inference < 400ms for our 2k token baseline
- Throughput: sustain 60 reqs/min across parallel workers
- Quality: Rouge-L / task-specific metric >= your baseline on 3 sample prompts
- Reliability: zero data exfil concerns; logs retained for 30 days

Concrete asks for this week (compact):
1) LumenSoft to confirm the two evaluation personas and provide 3 sample prompts (owner: Javier; due: Mon 8/23)
2) LumenSoft infra contact to confirm VPC peering details + allowlist IPs (owner: Priya or Tom; due: Wed 8/25)
3) Redwood to provision a 2-week dedicated trial pool and share runbook + metrics template (owner: Ben/Monica; due: Fri 8/20)

Attachments: [PoC-Runbook-v1.pdf], [trial-metrics-template.xlsx]

If these look right, reply with confirmations and any tweaks; we'll lock the schedule once we have the sample prompts and network details.

Thanks,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
[attachment: PoC-Runbook-v1.pdf]

Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC jumpstart - compact checklist, owners & this-week asks

Thanks Mina — appreciate the concise plan. Quick confirmations and two small asks from our side:

1) Success criteria: the latency target looks good; can we add a secondary metric for median latency (< 120ms) so our frontend team can validate UX?
2) Sample prompts: we will share the 3 prompts by end of day Monday (owner: Javier).
3) VPC access: Priya is copying infra lead Tom Nguyen (t.nguyen@lumensoft.com) to coordinate peering. Tom will confirm IPs by Wednesday.

One potential blocker: some of our sample prompts include proprietary identifiers — we need clarity on log retention and masking. Can you confirm Redwood's default masking guidance?

Thanks,
Javier Rosales
Head of Product, LumenSoft
j.rosales@lumensoft.com

Looping in to confirm Redwood's operational pieces and owners. Short answers to Javier's questions:

- Masking / logs: by default Redwood stores inference logs with prompt hashes and response text for 30 days in the customer's control plane; we can enable prompt masking to redact PII/proprietary tokens (configurable on the runbook). We will send the masking options in the runbook.
- Trial provisioning: we will provision a 2-week dedicated trial pool (4 GPUs) and a test namespace this week.

Owner assignments and dates (confirmed):
- Redwood provisioning & runbook updates: Ben Carter / Monica Patel — delivery Fri 8/20 (see attached trial-metrics-template.xlsx)
- LumenSoft sample prompts + persona mapping: Javier — delivery Mon 8/23
- Network peering & allowlist: Tom Nguyen (Lumensoft) — delivery Wed 8/25

If LumenSoft needs an earlier start on data-masking configs, Monica can jump on a 30m call Tuesday. Let us know preferred time windows.

Attachments: [trial-metrics-template.xlsx]

Thanks,
Ben Carter

Appreciate the clarity. Quick update from infra:
- Tom confirms peering request submitted but needs our org's template for the allowlist. He asked if Redwood can provide the minimal IP + CIDR set and an outbound allowlist for telemetry.
- Data masking: product is okay with masking, but we need an example config. Can Monica share a sample masking policy?

New ask from our side (small blocker):
- We need a simple NDA addendum for the sample prompts — legal wants a 1-paragraph addendum that says Redwood will not surface raw prompts outside the trial project. Can Redwood provide a short clause we can attach?

We remain on track but the NDA addendum + allowlist sample will be the gating items for peering.

Thanks,
